Status.Name: Stream Deck status
Status.Label: Show status
Status.Hint: Plugin connection, detected devices, active keys.

Enabled.Name: Connect to the Stream Deck from this browser
Enabled.Hint: The Stream Deck must be plugged into the computer displaying Foundry. "Auto": only the GM connects (avoids a browser local-network permission prompt for players).

Host.Name: Plugin address
Host.Hint: Keep 127.0.0.1 if the Stream Deck is on this computer.

Port.Name: Plugin port
Port.Hint: Must match the port set in the Stream Deck plugin (3006 by default).

Notify.Name: Connection notifications
Notify.Hint: Show a message when the Stream Deck connects or disconnects.

PairingCode.Name: Pairing code
PairingCode.Hint: Code shown in the Stream Deck plugin (settings of any VTT Deck key → Foundry connection). It stops websites and other devices from pretending to be Foundry or the plugin. Enter it once in each browser that drives the Stream Deck.

Status.Title: VTT Deck status
Status.NotReady: The module is not ready yet.
Status.Connected: Connected to the Stream Deck plugin
Status.Replaced: Another Foundry window controls the Stream Deck
Status.Waiting: Waiting for the Stream Deck plugin…
Status.Help: Make sure the Stream Deck app is running and the "VTT Deck" plugin is installed. Test: open http://127.0.0.1:3006 in the browser, the plugin should answer "OK".
Status.Remote: The Stream Deck is on another computer: the link is not encrypted, use it only on a trusted network.
Status.NoChallenge: The program on this port does not ask for the pairing code (old or fake plugin): connection refused, retrying shortly

Notify.Replaced: VTT Deck: another Foundry window took control of the Stream Deck. Use "Reconnect" in the module settings to take it back.
Notify.AuthNoCode: VTT Deck: enter the pairing code shown in the Stream Deck plugin (module settings → Pairing code).
Notify.AuthBadCode: VTT Deck: wrong pairing code. Copy the code shown in the Stream Deck plugin again (module settings → Pairing code).
Notify.AuthBadProof: VTT Deck: the program on the Stream Deck port did not prove it is the VTT Deck plugin. Connection refused.
Notify.Legacy: VTT Deck: your Stream Deck plugin is old and does not protect the connection. Please update it (1.5.1 or later).

Errors.NoTokenOnScene: VTT Deck: no matching token on the scene.
Errors.ChooseStatus: VTT Deck: pick a status in the Stream Deck app.
Errors.NoBar: VTT Deck: this token has no bar 1 configured.
Errors.MacroNoPermission: VTT Deck: you may not execute "{name}".
Errors.NoSelection: VTT Deck: select one or more tokens first.
Errors.NoCombatNoSelection: VTT Deck: no combat. Select the tokens to add to combat.
Errors.ChooseFile: VTT Deck: pick an audio file.

Pro.Required: VTT Deck: this feature is part of VTT Deck Premium.
